bio.text: Tammy Exum represents Connecticut's 19th House District (West Hartford and Avon), first elected in a special election in April 2019, and is Vice Chair of the Appropriations Committee and a Deputy Majority Leader.
She began her career as an elementary school teacher after earning a bachelor's degree in early childhood education, and later earned a master's degree in business administration.
She moved to West Hartford in 1999 and is a former vice chair of the West Hartford Board of Education.
